$comment: Machine-readable inventory of what this project has built, held, and not yet started. Validated by `python3 scripts/harness.py --only manifest`: every path must exist, every verb must be dispatchable, every status must be in the enum, and every id must be unique. A stale entry fails the gate rather than quietly misleading the next reader.

stages.name: Instrumentation and goldens
stages.gate: none - no behaviour change by design
stages.summary: Measurement before change. budget report, golden reference set, bench scorer, baseline recorded. SKILL.md and workflows/ left byte-identical deliberately.

stages.name: Cost wins that cannot touch quality
stages.summary: Model/effort tiering, MCP preflight, audit.py verbs replacing inline heredocs, dispatch briefs as files, return contracts. First stage to edit the shipped skill; the installer fix was a hard dependency of the verbs.

stages.name: Structural change
stages.gate: tplink re-run twice - cost must fall, recall >= 9/19
stages.summary: audit_core extracted (db, extract, annotations, coverage, sweep, budget), R1 and R3 landed, vendored into the skill with phase semantics unchanged.

stages.name: Quality additions
stages.gate: tplink re-run twice - cost must fall, recall >= 9/19; tiering half measured separately on precision
stages.summary: Five mechanisms, each answering a named cause of a missed CRITICAL in the tplink post-mortem: pivot rule, sweep-on-confirm, coverage denominator, identity discipline, chain composition. The Sonnet tiering half is held - see feature sonnet-tiering.

stages.name: Measurement hardening and parked defects
stages.gate: none - no audit run, no change to audit output
stages.summary: Deterministic leading indicators (parent spec 6.1), severity agreement and coverage in bench, an advisory severity re-rating report, and the four defects Stages 0 and 1 parked. Ships while the benchmark gates are deferred on cost, because nothing in it changes what an audit records.

stages.name: qualify - the hard GO/NO-GO gate
stages.gate: none - no audit run; scores an existing CSV
stages.summary: The first vertical slice of firmware-audit. Scores one vendor|model against the hunting plan's three filters and refuses to start a pipeline on a target that cannot pay. Deterministic work against _intel/target-scores.csv, verifiable at zero audit cost.

stages.name: Core hardening - coverage gate and mutation harness
stages.summary: Two instruments, no audit behaviour change. A sys.monitoring coverage gate with an allowlist (115 unexecuted of 2,392 statements to 0) and an opt-in mutation harness (1068 mutants, 66.3% killed) that finds tests which execute a line while asserting nothing about it. Added tests and tooling only; claims no movement in recall or precision.

stages.name: acquire and triage - firmware provenance and inventory
stages.gate: none - no audit run; unit, corpus consistency, and existing read-only benchmark checks
stages.summary: The second vertical slice of firmware-audit. Records two firmware-image roles, inventories an already-carved rootfs, reads bounded ELF facts, discovers evidenced boot services, and ships the triage agent brief. It does not fetch, carve, diff, infer open ports, or create the separate firmware-audit skill tree.

stages.name: diff - image-scoped firmware comparison and patch analysis brief
stages.gate: none - no audit run; full harness, read-only corpus consistency, and existing benchmark scoring
stages.summary: Migrates firmware facts to image-scoped keys, hashes regular-file manifests, compares acquired target/reference pairs deterministically, persists complete changed-path results with content-addressed JSON, and ships the semantic patch-analysis brief. Target-only inventory mirroring protects coverage; general surface mapping remains Stage 4d.

stages.name: surface - evidence-backed firmware dispatch mapping and completion
stages.gate: none - no audit run; focused regressions, full harness, and existing read-only benchmark scoring
stages.summary: Merged into local main at 6eba6d6 (last implementation b14b4fb), not pushed. Verifies the live target root, prepares deterministic full-manifest batches, imports strict agent results atomically, records state and settling questions, and gates complete coverage with canonical evidence for every batch. Database inventory and surface coverage use deterministic image-qualified unit keys while artifacts and surface-facing paths stay raw. Overlapping targets are isolated without schema changes; ambiguous old raw surface coverage is refused/preserved. Stage 4e consumes its verified generation; the surface gate retains its orphan-candidate scan scaling limitation.

stages.name: hunt - evidence-bound two-lane firmware candidate analysis
stages.gate: make all: 8/8 gates; 2,925 tests; 0/4,946 uncovered statements; merged locally at 8119af1, not pushed
stages.summary: Merged into local main at 8119af1, not pushed. Independent L-sink and L-dark worklists cover the complete selected target denominator and bind candidates to current surface evidence. Stage 4f is merged into local main at 303232e and Stage 4g at 30ca3ba. Stage 4h dive is merged locally; Stage 4j report is next after Stage 4i integration.

stages.name: fpcheck - dedicated static firmware review
stages.gate: merged-tree make all: 8/8 gates; 4,164 tests; 0/5,933 uncovered statements; scoped final re-review clean; paid semantic milestone gates deferred
stages.summary: Stage 4f is merged into local main at 303232e after clean scoped final re-review. Stage 4g chain is merged into local main at 30ca3ba; Stage 4h dive is merged locally; Stage 4j report is next after Stage 4i integration. Dedicated receipt-owned verdicts and false-positive pivots produce canonical static-reviewed findings; no generic promotion, severity or runtime claims.

stages.name: chain - global static firmware evidence graphs
stages.gate: merged-tree make all: 8/8 gates; 5,902 tests; 0/7,392 uncovered statements; scoped final re-review clean; paid semantic milestone gates deferred
stages.summary: Merged into local main at 30ca3ba, not pushed. Six dedicated image/snapshot-owned tables retain exact finding dispositions, reciprocal settleable blockers, reusable deterministic chains and typed ordered edges with mechanical device-state continuity. Generic source-code chain behavior remains compatible. Static-chained evidence makes no runtime, severity or exploit claim. Stage 4h dive is merged locally; Stage 4j report is next after Stage 4i integration.

stages.name: dive - runtime evidence settlement
stages.gate: final make all: 8/8 gates; 8,168 tests; 30 verbs; 44 tables / 43 contracts; four migrations; 6 CRLF / 243 LF; 65 features / 16 stages / 21 open items; 120 installed markdown files, zero sentinels; 0/11,376 unexecuted statements, zero allowed; benchmark recall 9/19, 45 findings, precision 39/40, $73.15 per match; whole-branch review fixes in 3ba4814 and scoped re-review clean
stages.summary: Merged into local main at dcfb01e, not pushed. Exact frozen questions, bounded acquisitions, immutable observations and current overlays feed deterministic Stage 4g regeneration. The bounded dive CLI and installed per-question worker route are complete. Stage 4i decide is implemented and reviewed on its unmerged feature branch; Stage 4j report is next; inherited milestone and scaling limitations remain.

stages.name: decide - immutable firmware acquisition decisions
stages.gate: make all: 8/8 gates; 8,599 tests; 31 verbs; 45 tables / 44 contracts; four migrations; 6 CRLF / 259 LF; 66 features / 17 stages / 21 open items; 124 installed markdown files, zero sentinels, real install untouched; 0/13,103 unexecuted statements, zero allowed; benchmark recall 9/19, 45 findings, precision 39/40, $73.15 per match; whole-branch review and scoped fixes through 4287d15 and a28e06e: 0 Critical/Important; coverage-fix scoped review: 0 Critical/Important/Minor; final whole-branch review fixed in 8a0b2a3 (ordered member path, copied upstream text) and scoped re-review: 0 Critical/Important
stages.summary: Implemented and independently reviewed through 8a0b2a3 on stage4i-firmware-decide, not merged or pushed. One lifecycle row per image and decision generation binds exact current chain/dive authority and separately hashed policy to immutable global worklists, strict results and canonical acquisition decision packages. The bounded decide CLI and one-global-worker route are complete; Stage 4j report is next after explicit integration.

stages.name: firmware-audit
stages.gate: tplink >= 12/19 at <= $45, and the asus golden must also pass
stages.summary: Firmware phases qualify, acquire/triage, diff, surface, hunt, fpcheck, chain and dive are merged through Stage 4h. Stage 4i decide is implemented and reviewed through 8a0b2a3 on its unmerged feature branch; Stage 4j report is next after integration. The Asus golden, monorepo/submodule decision and separate firmware skill tree remain open.

stages.name: Alignment
stages.summary: Backport the shared core to grey-audit and build its Stage 2/3 on the same spine.

features.name: Exact firmware acquisition decision authority, package and route
features.notes: Implemented and independently reviewed through 8a0b2a3 on the feature branch; integration and push remain pending. cba_firmware_decide_runs is keyed by (image_id, decision_generation), with at most one active generation per image and retained completed history. Only an exact current completed graph and completed non-contested dive input plus separately hashed operator policy can produce a package. Complete chain/precondition coverage, contiguous ranks, fixed recommendation precedence, carried bench state and inert mode-0600 scripts are enforced. Preparation uses files/firmware-decide/<decision-generation>/{policy,worklist}.json; results use artifacts/firmware-decide-results/<decision-generation>/<result-sha256>/result.json; packages use artifacts/firmware-decide/<decision-generation>/<package-sha256>/decision.json and bench/<name>. verified_package is the only later report authority and never falls back or repairs terminal artifacts. Stage 4j report is next after integration. Mutation, paid milestone, Asus golden, second indicators, real hardware/corpus, Linux/alternate-interpreter execution, separate firmware skill tree and monorepo/submodule decision remain open; triage is upsert-only and Stage 4d retains orphan-scan scaling.

features.name: Firmware dive persistence contracts
features.notes: Merged through dcfb01e. Six additive tables provide row-local contracts, canonical JSON and variant validation. The schema has 44 SQLite tables and 43 TableSpecs; four migrations remain unchanged. Question, acquisition, result, completion and journal semantics are validated by their owning modules.

features.name: Read-only verified current and retained firmware graph snapshots
features.notes: Merged through dcfb01e. Frozen sorted records reconstruct current completed Stage 4g graphs without writes and support read-only SQLite and caller transactions. Explicit retained verification is limited to exact image/dive-generation owners and rechecks current Stage 4f/source evidence; public current snapshots never fall back to history.

features.name: Pure strict firmware dive questions and packet authority
features.notes: Merged through dcfb01e. Frozen strict manifest, question and contract records require current graph subjects. Stable full-SHA-256 identities exclude local presentation fields. Automatic blockers and linked unknowns produce exact resolution contracts; retries bind contiguous history, conflicts require exact superseding sets, and packets authorize bounded retained or future acquisition evidence without embedding bodies.

features.name: Immutable firmware dive generation preparation
features.notes: Merged through dcfb01e. Complete immutable denominators, frozen journal reuse, durable generation reconstruction and exact retained authority are verified artifact-first under BEGIN IMMEDIATE. Ordinary preparation requires the current graph; conflict-only preparation requires an exact completed retained owner and complete current conflict set. Exact retries and historical generations remain immutable.

features.name: Sealed question-owned hardware captures
features.notes: Merged through dcfb01e. Strict question-owned capture specs bind device, firmware, state, operator/source, method and acquisition contract. Descriptor-anchored no-follow reads and installs accept only bounded regular evidence, publish append-only receipts atomically, preserve siblings on failure, make no conclusion and never contact a device.

features.name: Bounded no-network question-owned firmware probes
features.notes: Merged through dcfb01e. Strict question-owned probes stage only declared verified dependencies and use known bwrap or sandbox-exec isolation with no network, shell, ambient environment or fallback. Shared sealed limits cap address space where enforceable, processes, descriptors, streams and output files; unsupported containment fails closed. Manifests retain exact runtime facts but make no conclusion. Real tools, Linux and alternate Python remain unverified.

features.name: Pure strict firmware dive results and content identities
features.notes: Merged through dcfb01e. The bounded strict result parser distinguishes explicit empty from one-question answers, rejects coercion and worker-derived authority, and derives canonical observation and receipt identities from exact assignments, effects, dependencies and evidence. Pure parsing writes no SQL or files.

features.name: Exact firmware dive result authority and immutable observation import
features.notes: Merged through dcfb01e. Read-only validation reconstructs the exact pending assignment and retained Stage 4f/graph authority. Static evidence must be packet-authorized; dynamic evidence must belong to an exact question-owned sealed acquisition. Artifact-first import repeats authority under BEGIN IMMEDIATE and atomically publishes receipt, observation and dependencies without completing the generation.

features.name: Exact firmware dive journals and dependency-current resolution overlay
features.notes: Merged through dcfb01e. Independent completion reconstructs the complete denominator, results, successors, acquisitions, rows and currentness before publishing canonical journals and overlays. Only completed, current, conclusive and non-contested observations enter the overlay. Changed overlay bytes atomically invalidate Stage 4g; complete rechecks are byte/row exact and never repair.

features.name: Current dive overlay consumption, bounded CLI and installed worker routing
features.notes: Merged through dcfb01e. Stage 4g consumes only a strict current overlay with explicit settlement subjects and mandatory refuted-reachability constraints. The installed route repeats prepare, one global worker, root-bound record and check. Dive CLI output is bounded; per-question workers own result JSON only; probes fail closed without memory containment. Generic chain behavior remains compatible.

features.name: Global static firmware evidence graph pipeline
features.notes: Merged into local main at 30ca3ba; not pushed. One verified complete Stage 4f snapshot produces an immutable global worklist. Exact dispositions cover every finding and permit reusable chain membership. Typed adjacent edges bind semantic capability/link identity, producer/consumer-owned retained evidence and mechanically continuous lifecycle/posture/authentication state; explicit device boundaries need evidence on both sides. Stage 4d unknowns and new blockers remain settleable; blocker-side affected nonmaterialized findings require reciprocal blocked dispositions and references; pivots are context-only. Canonical artifact-first import and final reconstruction are snapshot/image-isolated, deterministic and atomically invalidated when Stage 4f evidence changes. The ninth installed brief assigns one strongest global worker while preserving generic source-code chain behavior. Static-chained evidence does not prove runtime reachability, severity, exploitability or semantic causality beyond retained evidence. Whole-branch review's two Important invariant findings were fixed in 661c3c9 and scoped re-review was clean; final review's blocker reciprocity finding was fixed in 7dad245 and the complete fix wave passed scoped re-review. Stage 4h dive is merged locally; Stage 4j report is next after Stage 4i integration; triage upsert-only snapshots and Stage 4d orphan-scan scaling persist.

features.name: Complete firmware static review pipeline
features.notes: Merged into local main at 303232e after clean scoped final re-review; not pushed. Stage 4g chain is merged into local main at 30ca3ba; Stage 4h dive is merged locally; Stage 4j report is next after Stage 4i integration. Exact root-cause keys alone group findings; global duplicates terminate at true positives; false positives retain one pivot. Static-only review inherits triage upsert-only snapshots and Stage 4d orphan-scan scaling. Deterministic verification does not measure paid semantic quality.

features.name: Session economics report
features.notes: Parses a Claude Code JSONL session into epochs, prefix, growth and attribution. Two measurement defects were found and fixed after the first baseline; see docs/baselines/2026-10-05-tplink-baseline.md.

features.name: Golden reference scoring
features.notes: Recall, cost per match and (since Stage 3) precision. matches.json and rejections.json are human adjudications and are never written by a tool.

features.name: Project-scoped MCP preflight (R4)
features.notes: Writes a config naming only the servers a run needs, to cut the MCP share of the context prefix. Its output has never reached a client that actually connected a real MCP server - see open_items.

features.name: Dispatch briefs as files (R6)
features.notes: A brief is rendered to a file and its path passed to the subagent, rather than pasted into the prompt.

features.name: Installer copies audit.py and audit_core
features.notes: A hard dependency of R5, not an independent item: install.sh originally copied only prose, so the first workflow to invoke audit.py broke every installed copy. __SKILL_DIR__ is sed-substituted per client so each copy calls its own.

features.name: Model and reasoning-effort tiering
features.notes: The measured 18.0% thinking term. Mechanical work only - the quality-risking half is held, see sonnet-tiering.

features.name: Subagent return contracts (R2)
features.notes: Everything stays in SQL and the artifact; widen the query, never the return.

features.name: Validated, bounded audit.db access
features.notes: TABLE_SPECS is the single contract: columns, required columns and validators. db.py is the only writer. put(replace=True) merges rather than replaces - a bare INSERT OR REPLACE dropped columns a different workflow step writes.

features.name: Extract once, fan out without a cap (R1)
features.notes: The orchestrator never holds raw material. Carries a batch-boundary one-writer assertion.

features.name: Context ceiling with checkpoint-restart (R3)
features.notes: Projection plus an external check, so a run survives its own length.

features.name: Append-only annotation journal
features.notes: Comprehension that survives a restart. Bounded index; tolerant of a CRLF-terminated line.

features.name: Bounded corpus sweep for a confirmed pattern
features.notes: ROOT_ONLY_SKIP_DIRS holds 'reports' and is applied only at the walk root - skipping it at any depth hid a real strcpy in src/reports/export.c.

features.name: Shipped skill linted against the economics contract
features.notes: The only automated check on prose that is not a content assertion. Pins the retired queries and the __SKILL_DIR__ sentinel.

features.name: Three independent internal consistency checks
features.notes: Verbs vs parser, TABLE_SPECS vs schema.sql, MIGRATIONS vs the frozen pre-Stage-3 baseline. Each compares two structures built independently - a tool's output is only trustworthy against something it did not produce.

features.name: In-place column migration
features.notes: SQLite has no ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS and CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS is a no-op on an existing table, so editing schema.sql repairs nothing on a database that already exists. connect() refuses an unmigrated database; selftest proves the loop against a frozen baseline.

features.name: A FALSE_POSITIVE must say what refuted it
features.notes: And what that refutation enables. A dismissal that leaves no trail loses the observation underneath it. All failure checks precede the first write.

features.name: An unswept registered pattern is a reportable gap
features.notes: A confirmed bug becomes a registered pattern; sweep.record marks it swept and refuses a truncated result. One instance of a bug class is rarely the only one.

features.name: Coverage denominator with a phase-exit gate
features.notes: Analyzed over inventoried, with a reason for every gap. The gate must be --phase scoped; unscoped it reported PASS/100% on a run whose audited phase never opened the only unit. It gates but does not block.

features.name: An asserted identity needs non-circular evidence
features.notes: Evidence that is not the component's own filename, at least MIN_EVIDENCE_CHARS long, with novel tokens after text.NOISE_WORDS filtering. 'the file is named km0_boot_0C000020.elf' is the circular reasoning this rejects.

features.name: Cross-group exploit chain proposal
features.notes: Measured on the real corpus for the first time and found unusable as designed - 100 candidates capped, 33 of 45 findings never examined as enablers and nothing saying so. Retuned to 24 candidates uncapped, all 45 examined, with unexamined findings reported.

features.name: Precision scored alongside recall
features.notes: The 'before' half of the held tiering gate. Currently 39/40 against 47.4% recall - the signature of an FP-check that is not filtering much, which is why the output carries its caveat on the same screen as the figure.

features.name: Sonnet downgrade for feature mapping and FP-check
features.notes: Spec-mandated, deliberately not applied: no precision baseline exists on the current configuration, so there is no 'before' to measure against. The gate document carries the exact five-file diff; applying it later is transcription. Two guard tests keep it from being applied by accident.

features.name: Eight-gate verification harness
features.notes: tests, selftest, lint, eol, manifest, install, bench. Five of the seven were previously run by hand from memory in an order nobody wrote down; eol and manifest were not checked by anything at all. The install gate refuses to run if its sandbox HOME resolves to the real one and asserts afterwards that all four real destinations' mtimes did not move.

features.name: Enforced CRLF/LF manifest
features.notes: Nothing previously pinned which files carry CRLF. test_install.py checks only that whatever shipped with CRLF keeps it through an install, which cannot notice a file that lost its CRLF before the install ran.

features.name: Progress, handoff, architecture and feature inventory
features.notes: Written so another agent can resume without reading a compacted transcript.

features.name: firmware-audit sibling skill
features.notes: Spec section 4: qualify as a hard gate, diff before hunt, two non-transferable hunt lanes, decide replacing verify, emulation as a capability rather than a phase.

features.name: Monorepo restructure
features.notes: Spec section 3.1. Submodule plus sync.sh is the fallback if grey-audit must keep its separate history.

features.name: Cross-target pattern library
features.notes: Spec section 3.5.2. Recorded as a deliberate omission from Stage 3; destination Stage 4.

features.name: Backport the core to grey-audit
features.notes: Spec section 7, Stage 5. Build grey-audit's Stage 2/3 - hunt, fpcheck, verify, report, Lanes B/C/D - on the shared spine.

features.name: Deterministic leading indicators
features.notes: Coverage percentage, surfaces opened, sweep hit counts and not_audited rows, with dated JSON snapshots under docs/indicators/ and a --compare that names what moved. The between-milestone substitute the parent spec 6.1 names and nobody built. Three of the four have no data in any existing audit.db, so they ship verified against fixtures.

features.name: Severity agreement scoring in bench
features.notes: Additive: recall keeps its meaning so 9/19 and the >=12/19 target stay valid, with severity-weighted recall emitted alongside. Measurable today for free against the stored baseline; the expected result is four under-rated matches with REF-17 the worst delta.

features.name: Coverage scoring in bench
features.notes: Parent spec 6.1 defines bench as scoring recall, precision, coverage and cost per finding. It scores three of the four.

features.name: Advisory severity re-rating report
features.notes: Reports findings whose recorded severity disagrees with their own cited evidence, and stores nothing. Its own verb rather than part of bench because it needs no golden set, so it works on every real client audit rather than only the one corpus with a reference set.

features.name: absent is not zero, in every new reader
features.notes: A pre-Stage-2 database has no cba_coverage table; reporting 0% claims total failure where the truth is no data. Every reader added in Stage 3b distinguishes a value, absent (no table) and empty (table, no rows). Same shape as the unscoped coverage gate that reported PASS/100% on a run that never opened the only unit.

features.name: Firmware target qualification
features.notes: Three filters, each failing closed. Filter 3 (still supported) is the binding one and has no data behind it, so it is asserted with evidence that must name something checkable - a date, a version or a host. db.check_identity_evidence alone was measured accepting 'Zyxel NWA50AX is supported', which is why the checkable-reference rule exists.

features.name: Statement coverage probe over audit_core
features.notes: sys.monitoring probe reporting which audit_core statements the suite never executes. Filters line 0 and multi-line signature continuations on both sides of the ratio. Only correct from a cold import graph, so the gate runs it as a subprocess.

features.name: Coverage allowlist gate
features.notes: Eighth gate. Every unexecuted statement must be listed with a reason; fails on an unlisted gap, a stale digest, and a listed line that now runs. Shells out to the probe CLI and checks pytest_rc. SKIPs below Python 3.12.

features.name: Mutation harness and gate
features.notes: AST mutation over temp copies of the tree, finding tests that execute a line while asserting nothing that depends on it. Opt-in: in GATES, in neither DEFAULT nor ALL_EXTRA, because ci.yml runs --all across three Python versions and the sweep takes about an hour. Run with make mutate.

features.name: Bounded, three-state ELF fact reader
features.notes: Pure stdlib ELF reader for architecture, linkage, dependencies and mitigations. Malformed offsets and partial tables return None or unknown facts rather than aborting a rootfs walk.

features.name: Firmware image provenance recorder
features.notes: Hashes and records a local target or diff-reference image. It never fetches, copies, carves, or alters firmware. Duplicate roles fail closed unless replace is explicit. A replacement changing the hash or version atomically clears only that image's triage manifest, requiring retriage before diff; Stage 4d also clears a changed target's dependent surface run, claims, unknowns, and old-unit surface coverage in that transaction.

features.name: Carved-rootfs inventory and evidenced boot services
features.notes: Turns an already-carved rootfs into file, ELF and boot-service rows. Empty and unacknowledged zero-ELF trees fail before any write; symlinks and nonregular entries are excluded; direct scandir traversal propagates scan, classification, and stat errors and rejects inconsistent directory classifications; regular files sort by relative path; prepared file, ELF, service, and coverage rows publish atomically. Failed fresh/retriage preserves all four publication tables. Acquired-target inventory uses db.firmware_unit_key while legacy-unscoped stays raw; retriage remains upsert-only. Ports remain agent-asserted and require evidence.

features.name: Image-scoped firmware manifests, durable comparison, and patch-analysis brief
features.notes: Last implementation commit is ea78e1b. Composite (image_id, path/name) keys preserve both images; the idempotent Stage 4b upgrade maps absent image IDs to legacy-unscoped and requires re-triage to populate manifests. Target-only inventory rule: target and compatible unscoped triage mirror cba_inventory; diff-reference triage never writes that coverage denominator. Stage 4d now qualifies acquired-target inventory and surface coverage keys; legacy-unscoped remains raw. Diff uses stored SHA-256 manifests and persists every changed path; content-addressed artifact installation precedes atomic SQL replacement. Changed acquired-image provenance clears the same-image manifest; read-side SQL errors are named. Triage upserts without pruning removed files, so refreshed carved trees require fresh scopes/runs. Agent analysis is patch-specific; surface mapping belongs to Stage 4d.

features.name: Exact-root firmware surface worklists, atomic results, completion gate, and agent brief
features.notes: Last implementation commit is b14b4fb; merged into local main at 6eba6d6, not pushed. Prepare verifies all target regular files by path/kind/size/SHA-256 and inventory agreement, rescans before publication, and writes canonical path-ordered batches (default 50, range 1..1000). Hints never reduce the complete target-manifest denominator. Strict 8 MiB results bind image/manifest/worklist/batch provenance and exactly one decision per unit; state unknowns require matching open settling questions, and analyzed no-surface units require a retained explanation or explanatory unknown. Canonical artifacts install before atomic batch-owned SQL; replace preserves sibling batches, import resets pending, and only check certifies complete with matching canonical evidence for every batch. Changed preparation/acquisition provenance invalidates dependent target state atomically; failures preserve prior SQL and may leave orphans. Expected SQL diagnostics are fixed; other expected diagnostics are escaped/capped at 512 ASCII characters plus newline; unexpected errors propagate after rollback. No audit, paid milestone benchmark, mutation sweep, or indicator snapshot ran; no fetch/carve/execute/hunt/severity/emulation/kernel/bootloader work or separate skill tree. Retained orphan-candidate scan scaling is a local-run performance limitation; future durable batch receipts should avoid it. db.firmware_unit_key qualifies acquired-target inventory and surface coverage units as /firmware/<image-ID Unicode character count>:<exact image ID>:<raw path>; legacy-unscoped remains raw. Generic coverage joins still match, and preparation/import/check/replacement/acquisition invalidation isolate overlapping targets. Manifests/worklists/results/surface and unknown component paths/human output remain raw. Old raw inventory is not accepted for acquired images; overlapping raw surface coverage refuses import even with replacement and is preserved by invalidation, requiring a fresh run when obstructed. ELF/service hints are image-scoped; globally keyed component hints remain advisory; triage is still upsert-only. New cross-image and encoding regressions are in tests/test_surface_gate.py. Stage 4e consumes the verified generation; the surface gate retains its orphan-candidate scan scaling limitation.

features.name: Stage 4f dedicated firmware review schema and row contracts
features.notes: Schema foundation of the implemented Stage 4f phase. Five additive tables retain image/generation/batch ownership for runs, receipts, verdicts, pivots and reviewed findings. Exact TableSpec contracts validate canonical unique JSON arrays, variant-specific evidence, bounded identifiers, lowercase digests, nonnegative counts, confidence 0-10, static-reviewed evidence rung, relative batch/component paths, and canonical stored paths. Phase modules enforce run containment and cross-row ownership. No generic findings/verdicts or column migrations change. The complete Stage 4f phase, firmware review brief and installed-user routing are merged into local main at 303232e after clean scoped final re-review; not pushed. Stage 4g chain is merged into local main at 30ca3ba; Stage 4h dive is merged locally; Stage 4j report is next after Stage 4i integration.

features.name: Read-only verified completed firmware hunt snapshot
features.notes: hunt.verified_snapshot shares the complete Stage 4e verifier with hunt.check, requires both lanes already complete and performs no SQL writes or status/timestamp transitions. Frozen lane/candidate/blocker records retain full candidate evidence and lane-qualified identity. Canonical artifact paths are verified run descendants and exposed run-relative. Supports read-only SQLite and caller-owned transactions; checks full denominators beyond the 200-row display cap and candidate-free lanes. Deterministic review preparation now consumes this helper; Stage 4f phase tables are not written by the helper itself.

features.name: Deterministic provenance-bound firmware review preparation
features.notes: Consumes the verified completed-hunt snapshot and exact live root. Canonical full-evidence candidate snapshots bind both hunt worklist digests and lane-qualified IDs with run-relative artifact provenance. Normalized priority-only similarity signatures never merge findings; equal signatures form deterministic indivisible clusters. Batch size is an integer from 1 to 200; clusters may exceed the target but clusters and emitted batches cannot exceed 1000. Empty hunts receive one empty batch. Immutable installation rejects symlink parents; locked revalidation repeats hunt/root/prior-run checks and installed-byte checks before pending-run publication. Index digest identifies the generation and binds batch policy. Same inputs preserve review state; changed preparation or explicit invalidation clears only the selected image's five review tables. Stage 4f is merged into local main at 303232e after clean scoped final re-review; not pushed. Stage 4g chain is merged into local main at 30ca3ba; Stage 4h dive is merged locally; Stage 4j report is next after Stage 4i integration.

features.name: Strict read-only firmware review result parsing and validation
features.notes: Frozen typed records preserve exact reviewer evidence. Strict UTF-8 JSON rejects duplicate keys, extra/missing fields, coercions, non-finite values and invalid or mismatched verdict variants. Raw and canonical output each have an 8 MiB cap. Rules require canonical HE-1..18, PR-1..10, CV-1..3 or MARGINAL-GAIN. Validation reuses completed hunt lane/artifact verification, rebuilds current canonical review worklists, requires a matching run with consistent pending/complete status and completion timestamp, and enforces exact lane-qualified assignment membership before verdict semantics including confidence 0-10. Image IDs retain the existing nonempty UTF-8 text contract; candidate/pivot/root/surface IDs use bounded identifiers. Reviewed components and surfaces must belong to selected-image evidence; duplicate targets must be in-snapshot and non-self, with global chains resolved by the final completion gate. No SQL/artifact writes, live-root access, publication, completion or CLI; read-only SQLite and caller transactions supported. Stage 4f is merged into local main at 303232e after clean scoped final re-review; not pushed. Stage 4g chain is merged into local main at 30ca3ba; Stage 4h dive is merged locally; Stage 4j report is next after Stage 4i integration.

features.name: Atomic batch-owned firmware review import
features.notes: Installs canonical immutable artifacts beneath artifacts/firmware-fpcheck/<generation>/<result-sha256>/result.json before one BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction. Repeats current hunt/snapshot/worklist/assignment, prior receipt ownership and installed-byte checks under the lock. Publishes one receipt, one lane-qualified verdict per assigned candidate and one pivot per FALSE_POSITIVE with importer-owned provenance and SQL-default timestamps. Empty batches retain zero-count receipts. Duplicate imports require replace. Replacement isolates one image/current snapshot/batch; pivot removal joins exact lane-qualified source verdicts, preserving siblings and old snapshots. Clears selected-image derived findings and returns its run to pending. Read, install, SQL and commit failures preserve prior SQL; an unreferenced canonical artifact may remain. Unicode/delimiter image IDs never become host path components. Stage 4f is merged into local main at 303232e after clean scoped final re-review; not pushed. Stage 4g chain is merged into local main at 30ca3ba; Stage 4h dive is merged locally; Stage 4j report is next after Stage 4i integration.

features.name: Global firmware review verification and canonical reviewed findings
features.notes: check requires exact current receipts, verdicts and false-positive pivots and reconstructs them from immutable canonical result artifacts. Iterative path-compressed duplicate resolution is global across lanes/batches and rejects cycles, missing/self/foreign targets and non-TP terminals. Exact root-cause keys group contributors; similarity hints never merge. Canonical scalars come from the lexicographically first direct/terminal TRUE_POSITIVE, using its immutable candidate title/bug class and reviewed TP fields. Sorted unions retain all contributors/components/surfaces; confidence is the minimum including duplicates; evidence rung is static-reviewed. Finding IDs bind image, candidate snapshot and exact root key. Deterministic findings.json installs before one immediate transaction, with locked full hunt/live-root/input/artifact revalidation before derived rows and completion status publish. Completed rechecks require existing canonical artifact and matching derived rows and preserve timestamps. Empty and all-FP generations complete with zero findings. SQL/install/commit/lock failures preserve prior SQL; an unreferenced immutable artifact may remain. Dedicated Stage 4f outputs only; no generic findings/verdicts, dynamic evidence, severity or report claims. Stage 4f is merged into local main at 303232e after clean scoped final re-review; not pushed. Stage 4g chain is merged into local main at 30ca3ba; Stage 4h dive is merged locally; Stage 4j report is next after Stage 4i integration.

features.name: Atomic selected-image firmware review invalidation at upstream boundaries
features.notes: Local imports invoke the SQL-only Stage 4f invalidator with commit=False in existing upstream transactions. Changed selected-target hash/version or triage manifest, surface prepare/results, hunt prepare/results and real lane completion transitions clear only that image's dedicated runs, receipts, verdicts, pivots and findings. Byte-identical operations, sibling images and reference/supplemental acquisition changes preserve review state. Hunt result replacement compares receipt provenance/counts, qualified coverage and complete receipt-owned candidate rows; identical replacement preserves lane completion and timestamps, while durable row repair invalidates review. Real SQLite deletion failures at all five review tables roll back complete upstream/review snapshots. Unicode/delimiter image IDs and lane-qualified repeated candidate IDs stay isolated. Stage 4f is merged into local main at 303232e after clean scoped final re-review; not pushed. Stage 4g chain is merged into local main at 30ca3ba; Stage 4h dive is merged locally; Stage 4j report is next after Stage 4i integration. features.name: Bounded explicit firmware review prepare, record and check CLI
features.notes: Exactly one explicit prepare, record or check mode is required. Semantic flag errors exit 1 before database I/O; syntax errors exit 2. Prepare/check require root; batch targets are integers 1-200 with default 20; replace belongs only to record. The handler delegates validation, artifact publication and SQL ownership to the completed firmware boundaries. Success output whitelists scalar aggregates/provenance and artifact paths, using finding_count instead of per-finding review records; human display text is escaped, root-redacted and capped at 512 ASCII characters; JSON serializes the fixed scalar field set losslessly, preserving exact identities and usable artifact paths without the human per-string display cap. Expected diagnostics are escaped/capped at 512 ASCII characters plus newline; SQLite cause/context chains map to the fixed fpcheck database diagnostic. Unexpected direct-handler exceptions propagate after cleanup. Real subprocess tests cover candidate-bearing and empty generations, literal canonical review results, replacement, completion, clean stderr and private-evidence exclusion. Returned Unicode/delimiter identities and Unicode/long/root-prefix artifact paths round-trip through prepare, record, replacement and check. The existing prose workflow and generic source-code verdict commands retain their semantics. Stage 4f is merged into local main at 303232e after clean scoped final re-review; not pushed. Stage 4g chain is merged into local main at 30ca3ba; Stage 4h dive is merged locally; Stage 4j report is next after Stage 4i integration. Triage upsert-only snapshots and Stage 4d orphan scan scaling persist.

features.name: Firmware review worker brief and installed-user routing
features.notes: Eighth template uses the shared renderer and eight required provenance/path variables. Installed Claude and both Codex trees resolve parser and shared FP-rule references. Firmware routing uses immutable lane-qualified candidate batches and explicit prepare/record/check, preserving ordinary source-code fpcheck semantics. Workers apply attacker advantage first, shared HE/PR/CV/Marginal Gain rules, evidence rereads and cross-lane comparison; exact decisions preserve all candidates, pivots and duplicate targets. Strict result-only JSON is capped at 8 MiB; SQL, canonical installation and transitions remain deterministic. Static-only limits, no absolute-root persistence, PARTIAL checkpoints without fabricated decisions, and exactly one return line are explicit. Stage 4f is merged into local main at 303232e after clean scoped final re-review; not pushed. Stage 4g chain is merged into local main at 30ca3ba; Stage 4h dive is merged locally; Stage 4j report is next after Stage 4i integration. Triage upsert-only snapshots and Stage 4d orphan-scan scaling persist.

features.name: Evidence-bound two-lane firmware hunt, receipts, candidates, and agent brief
features.notes: Merged into local main at 8119af1, not pushed. Both lanes assign every selected target regular file exactly once and bind results to the current manifest and completed surface snapshot. Durable receipts own candidate-free batches; imports atomically publish receipt, image-qualified coverage, and candidates. not_applicable maps to analyzed coverage with its evidence-backed reason retained; budget skips fail the lane gate. Replacement is batch-scoped; changed acquisition, target triage, or surface evidence invalidates same-image hunts. Expected SQLite errors use the fixed hunt diagnostic; other expected errors are escaped/capped. Stage 4e remains firmware-audit functionality inside the shared codebase-audit repository, not a separately packaged skill. It inherits triage upsert-only snapshots and Stage 4d orphan-candidate scan scaling. Stage 4f is merged into local main at 303232e and Stage 4g at 30ca3ba, Stage 4h dive is merged locally; Stage 4j report is next after Stage 4i integration. The Asus golden and monorepo/submodule decision remain overall Stage 4 prerequisites.

open_items.summary: Nothing scores severity agreement, and nothing re-rates a finding once its chain is known. Of the nine reference CRITICALs the audit did find, four were rated below the reference - REF-17, a pre-auth authentication bypass, was filed LOW.
open_items.note: bench loads `severity` on both sides and compares neither. Recall therefore understates the problem: half the findings that were made were under-rated. Severity is a claim about reachability and consequence, and the pipeline fixes it at discovery time, before chain composition runs. Recorded at the end of Stage 0 as an input to later stages; never actioned.

open_items.summary: `--server NAME=COMMAND` silently overwrites a `--keep`-copied server of the same name with a bare {"command": ...}, discarding args and env.
open_items.note: Reproduced 2026-10-07: --from-config src.json --keep autorev --server autorev=uvx writes {"command": "uvx"} and exits 0, losing the args and env that made the server work. This is precisely the degradation load_servers' docstring says --keep exists to prevent. Untested in either direction.

open_items.summary: The supported-case NO-GO footer is redundant and hedges.
open_items.note: It reads "...so findings pay zero. It pays zero and costs thousands..." and says "either the operator declared it unsupported or the support claim is not checkable" although the filter line directly above states which.

open_items.summary: Filter 3 is not a gate against an operator who wants a GO.
open_items.note: It blocks absent and lazy assertions and forces the claim into the output where a later reader can falsify it, but any 20+ character string containing a year and one novel token passes (e.g. "it is not supported anymore as of 2020"). Recorded as a known property of the rule, not a bug.

open_items.summary: The coverage and mutate gates measure audit_core only (harness.py passes --package audit_core), so coverage_probe.py, coverage_allowlist.py, mutate.py, mutation-verify.py and gate_coverage's own failure branches are unmeasured by the tools they implement.
